speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic hypersensitivity. The presence of eosinophiluria despite a sterile urine culture and normal imaging confirms an allergic kidney injury rather than a typical bacterial infection, likely triggered by the sulfa-based antibiotic you recently took.
